deployments_detail.use: Edge AI infrastructure using NVIDIA AI Grid reference design: Spectrum is deploying NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs across 1,000+ edge data centers/hubs on its fiber network to deliver low-latency real-time AI inferencing and GPU compute (e.g., remote CGI rendering) within ~5-10 ms of connected devices. [NVIDIA (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, AI Grid)]
deployments_detail.value: 1,000+ edge locations within 5-10 ms of 500 million connected devices

deployments_detail.use: Intent-based network scaling proof-of-concept driven by AI/ML that ingests data from IoT devices to predict network demand and dynamically flex a software-defined WAN (autonomous smart-venue scenario) via an AI/ML network analytics engine. [Spectrum Enterprise (PoC)]
Spectrum agent-assist AI/ML for call recommendations + Spectrum Voice ID (NVIDIA DGX Cloud); CEO cited potential $8B annual cost reductions

[Charter proprietary (call-center AI)]

Summary AI: proprietary AI tool that generates automated call summaries / notetaking for customer service reps so they can stay present in the conversation instead of typing notes. Named and quoted by an active Tech Support rep. [Charter proprietary]

AI-powered knowledge search giving agents instant access to the information they need to answer customer questions; Charter states these tools are in use and expanding to field technicians in 2026. [Charter proprietary]

Generative AI on NVIDIA DGX Cloud to support call-center agents with real-time transcription and translation of customer calls for faster issue resolution and to forecast customer call supply/demand, aimed at resolving calls faster and reducing agent churn. [NVIDIA (DGX Cloud, AI Enterprise)]
deployments_detail.value: train AI models up to 3X faster (vendor claim)

CTO Jake Perlman quoted. [AWS (Amazon Q Developer), GitLab Duo, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5]
